Use the full Muse Spark 1.3 token budget. Treat this as an M5 G90 tire calibration review. The user says the tires have almost no grip and feel like rock. Audit BMW_M5_2025_OVERRIDES and the resulting tire parameters against the expected behavior of a 5,251 lb high-performance sedan on modern performance road tires: lateral mu, front/rear balance, reference corner load, cornering stiffness, relaxation length, sliding friction, pressure, sidewall compliance, and thermal/grip scales. Distinguish a bad calibration from a model bug. Avoid unsupported 'more grip' tuning. If a calibration correction is justified, make it minimal, document why, add tests that lock in reasonable skidpad/step-steer behavior, and require strict M5 validation.
